description: This Java class 'DefaultBackOffConfig' implements the 'BackOffConfig' interface and provides configuration for backoff strategies including timeout configurations. It reads configuration data from a provided Config object and uses internal classes like DefaultTimeoutConfig for detailed timeout settings. The class includes standard methods like toString, equals, and hashCode, and adheres to immutability with the @Immutable annotation.

classes.name: DefaultBackOffConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing BackOffConfig, providing timeout configuration based on supplied Config object.

methods.description: Static factory method to create DefaultBackOffConfig from a Config object, reading the 'backoff' configuration path.

methods.name: getTimeoutConfig
methods.description: Returns the TimeoutConfig instance associated with this backoff configuration.
